faqs: What is Qavyo?
Qavyo is a connected operating system for retail and hospitality businesses. It brings inventory, POS, kitchen workflows, online ordering, and a customer website into one platform.
Who is Qavyo for?
Qavyo is built for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, takeaways, retail stores, salons, and growing multi-location businesses.
What is included?
Starter includes Inventory, POS, and KDS where relevant. Growth adds a customer website and online ordering. Specialist capabilities are available as add-ons.
Can I try Qavyo first?
Every business can explore Qavyo with a 30-day full-access trial. No card is required for the trial.
How does pricing work?
Qavyo has four core plans: Starter, Growth, Business, and Enterprise. Pricing is localized by country and selected add-ons.

faqs: How does regional pricing work?
Qavyo assigns a pricing region to your business from country and commercial context. The checkout amount is shown in the appropriate currency before you subscribe.
What is included in the free trial?
Every plan capability and add-on is available for 30 days. No card is required to start.
Can I add features later?
Yes. Add-ons such as Loyalty, Coupons, Payroll, Staff App, AI Analytics and Mobile App can be enabled when you need them.
Do you limit staff users?
No. Qavyo does not charge by staff seat. Add the people your business needs — the Staff Portal is included in every plan. Only the branded Staff App is a paid add-on.
Are lifetime options available?
Eligible plans and one-time software capabilities may offer a lifetime option. Services with continuing third-party costs remain recurring.
